Dødsfall i kamper beløp seg til 75 767 i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Israeli settlers seized eight Palestinian homes in Jericho, displacing dozens, and the IDF arrested three Palestinians planning terror attacks in the West Bank. In Gaza, gunfire damaged tents at the Rafah displacement site as aid teams prepared for winter storms, and residents built wind turbines from rubble and turned discarded cooking pots into seawalls. 21,440 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israelske bosettere tok over åtte palestinske hjem i Jeriko, og forflyttet dusinvis, og IDF arresterte tre palestinere som planla terrorangrep på Vestbredden. I Gaza ble telt på Rafah-flyktningesteder skadet av skudd mens hjelpearbeidere forberedte seg på vinterstormer, og innbyggere bygde vindturbiner av ruiner og gjorde om kastede gryter til sjøvoller. 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israel is conducting air, drone and ground operations in southern Lebanon, striking targets and carrying out detonations that have killed civilians and injured others, while Hezbollah fires artillery at Israeli positions and has begun cash payments to war victims and displaced families. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon by the fighting. Israel has also built a new road in the Shebaa Valley buffer zone, a development not mentioned previously. The conflict, which began in October 2023, continues to generate civilian hardship and displacement. 4,335 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

FN rapporterer at 300 000 personer er fordrevet i Libanon på grunn av kampene. Israel har også bygget en ny vei i bufferområdet Shebaa-dalen, en utvikling som ikke ble nevnt tidligere. Konflikten, som startet i oktober 2023, fortsetter å påføre sivile vanskeligheter og fordrivelse. 4 335 dødsfall knyttet til kamper fant sted i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi forces maintain a month-long siege of Taiz while Yemeni government troops have seized the strategic al-Jawf mountain range, intensifying front-line fighting. The coalition downed a Houthi ballistic missile aimed at Medina and intercepted another long-range anti-tank guided missile that struck a Saudi-backed vehicle, wounding a fighter. A market strike in southwestern Yemen killed at least 20 civilians, and a missile attack on an oil tanker in the Gulf killed a sailor. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Koalisjonen skjøt ned et houthi-ballistisk missil rettet mot Medina og avskjærte et annet langdistanse-antitankstyrt missil som traff et Saudi-støttet kjøretøy, og såret en fighter. Et markedstreff i sør-vestlige Jemen drepte minst 20 sivile, og et missilangrep på en oljetanker i Gulf drepte en sjømann. Konflikten forårsaket 918 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The UN peacekeeping chief warned that RSF drone strikes launched from Ethiopian territory pose a new threat to civilians, prompting Ethiopia to expel six Sudanese consular staff and close Sudan’s consulate, while Sudan shut the Ethiopian consulate in retaliation. Factories are struggling to restart after wartime damage. The conflict caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Ecuador is experiencing continued high-profile violence, with authorities summoning seven people to stand trial for plotting to murder a candidate and U.S. prosecutors charging the son of former President and four others with cocaine trafficking. A priest was killed when a crucifix fell from a church wall in the Galapagos, adding a fatal incident to the security crisis. The crisis, which began in 2018, had recorded two battle-related deaths in 2019, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Ecuador opplever fortsatt høyprofilerte voldshendelser, med myndighetene som har innkalt syv personer til rettssak for å ha planlagt drap på en kandidat, og amerikanske påtalemyndigheter som har siktet sønnen til den tidligere presidenten og fire andre for kokainhandel. En prest ble drept da et kors falt fra en kirkewall på Galapagos, noe som legger til en dødelig hendelse i sikkerhetskrisen. Krisen, som startet i 2018, hadde registrert to dødsfall i kamper i 2019, ifølge UCDP.

Rubio says the United States is in talks to establish a military presence in Venezuela and has floated a one-day operation to capture Maduro. The U.S. military is coordinating with Venezuela to launch drone strikes on cartels, and Trump defended the Hegseth amid an impeachment threat while citing successful operations in Iran and Venezuela. 2 battle-related deaths in 2007, according to UCDP.

Rubio sier at USA er i samtaler om å etablere en militær tilstedeværelse i Venezuela og har foreslått en ett-dags operasjon for å fange Maduro.
